findings.title: Fallback lookup hits SiteSetting and can raise on nil
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] in config/initializers/i18n.rb calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym on every lookup. I18n::Backend::Fallbacks calls fallbacks[locale] on every translated key, so every I18n.t now touches SiteSetting instead of using a cached chain. Worse, if default_locale is nil or empty the to_sym call raises NoMethodError before uniq.compact can run, breaking all translation with a 500. The lookup should handle nil safely and avoid per-translation SiteSetting access.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache ignores fallback chain
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb builds its LRU key as key + config.locale + backend object_id. With the new fallback chain of user locale -> SiteSetting.default_locale -> :en, the same key+locale can resolve differently when the site default locale changes or when different fallback files are loaded, but the cache key does not include the fallback locales. Changing SiteSetting.default_locale will keep serving stale cached strings until LRU eviction, and missing-translation results cached before fallbacks are loaded are frozen in.

findings.title: translate only loads current locale, not fallbacks
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb calls load_locale(config.locale) only, while loading of the fallback locales is done separately via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! called only from ApplicationController#set_locale. Any translation outside a web request (background jobs, mailers, console, initializers, model callbacks) will resolve fallbacks against unloaded YAML files, producing missing-translation strings that are then stored in the LRU cache. The translate path itself must ensure the full fallback chain is loaded.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! on every request does redundant locale loads
findings.body: ApplicationController#set_locale calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! on every request, which iterates user locale, site default locale, and :en and calls I18n.ensure_loaded! for each. This runs before preload_json and other translation-heavy work on every request even when the locales are already loaded, adding SiteSetting.default_locale lookups and @loaded_locales scans per request. It also only covers the controller path, leaving other entry points without loaded fallbacks.
